ports.name: clk
ports.description: Synchronous clock for the mailbox SRAM black box.

ports.name: mbox_sram_req_cs
ports.description: Chip select asserted by the mailbox FSM to start an SRAM access.

ports.name: mbox_sram_req_we
ports.description: Write-enable: 1 = write wdata to addr, 0 = read addr into resp_rdata.

ports.name: mbox_sram_req_addr
ports.description: 16-bit dword address into the mailbox payload buffer.

ports.name: mbox_sram_resp_rdata
ports.description: 32-bit read data returned by the SRAM (the read-after-write contract target).

annotations.value: G(mbox_sram_req_cs -> mbox_sram_req_addr stable for the access window)
